## Description {#details}

<p>C++ header file with the declarations of the deprecated µTest++ definitions.</p>


<p>This header groups the deprecated definitions that are not members of the framework classes, kept for compatibility with the applications written for the previous versions:</p>


<ul class="doxyList ">
<li>the v5.0.1 names of the logical functions (<span class="doxyComputerOutput">_not</span>, <span class="doxyComputerOutput">_and</span>, and <span class="doxyComputerOutput">_or</span>);</li>
<li>the v5.0.1 names of the type wrappers (<span class="doxyComputerOutput">_i</span>, <span class="doxyComputerOutput">_u8</span>, etc.);</li>
<li>the v5.0.1 names of the classes (<span class="doxyComputerOutput">subtest</span>, <span class="doxyComputerOutput">static_runner</span>, <span class="doxyComputerOutput">detail::runner_totals</span>, and <span class="doxyComputerOutput">detail::timestamps</span>);</li>
<li>the <span class="doxyComputerOutput">detail::timestamp</span> class;</li>
<li>the <span class="doxyComputerOutput">reflection::short_name()</span> function;</li>
<li>the v5.0.1 <span class="doxyComputerOutput">type_traits</span> namespace.</li>
</ul>

<p>The deprecated member functions and data members remain in the declarations of their classes, since C++ does not allow them to be declared elsewhere.</p>


<p>Keeping the deprecated definitions separate makes them easy to identify and, in a future major release, to remove.</p>


<p>All definitions reside within the <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/namespaces/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus">micro_os_plus::micro_test_plus</a></span> namespace, ensuring clear separation from user code and minimising the risk of naming conflicts.</p>


<p>The header files are organised within the <span class="doxyComputerOutput">include/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus</span> folder to maintain a structured and modular codebase.</p>


<p>This file is intended for internal use within the framework and should not be included directly by user code.</p>
